scripts.build-distr-osx: cd ./src/gtk-app ; CARGO_TARGET_DIR=../../bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin cargo bundle --release ; cd ../../bin/distr/gtkapp-darwin ; mkdir -p ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas ; cp $(brew --prefix)/share/glib-2.0/schemas/org.gtk.gtk4.Settings*.xml ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas/ ; glib-compile-schemas ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/Resources/share/glib-2.0/schemas ; dylibbundler -s /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/lib/swift-5.0/macosx -s /Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx -s $(xcode-select -p)/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.0/macosx -s $(xcode-select -p)/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/lib/swift-5.5/macosx -od -b -x ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/MacOS/ice-commander -d ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/Libs/ -p @executable_path/../Libs/ ; cp ../../artifacts/libpdfium.dylib ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app/Contents/Libs/libpdfium.dylib ; codesign --force --deep --sign - ./release/bundle/osx/IceCommander.app
scripts.unit-tests: cargo test -p ice-commander-gtk && cargo test -p client-archives && cargo test -p common && cargo test -p client-config && cargo test -p panel-router && cargo test -p secret-store && cargo test -p ic-logging && cargo test -p gtk-viewer-ui && cargo test -p fm-core
scripts.licenses: cargo about generate --config about.toml about.hbs -o THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md
